note: annual-series: the catalog delivers value 2017..2021 and the steward holds it for 2018 and 2019 only (order/annual-series, order/outside-period). In the study window 2017..2021, a 2018 source warns that 2019 is also delivered; a 2018..2019 source warns nothing, though the catalog describes 2017 and 2020..2021, because a steward artifact counts only the days it holds. Fails if a source period narrower than its held columns stops warning, if the warning counts catalog days the steward does not hold, or if a source covering every held day warns.
